articles.title: Someone Keeps Leaking GTA 6 Videos, and They Look Amazing!
articles.summary: A mystery person keeps posting secret videos of the new Grand Theft Auto 6 game online. The latest clip shows super-realistic driving and puddle reflections. The game company is mad, but fans are excited. The official reveal is on Netflix on August 27.

articles.title: Two Tennis Stars Are Out of the US Open Because of Injuries
articles.summary: Jannik Sinner, the world's number one tennis player, and his friend Jack Draper both pulled out of the US Open because of injuries. Sinner has a knee problem, and Draper has a long-term arm injury. Sinner said he is very sad because New York is special to him.

articles.title: Robot Pool Cleaners That Do the Dirty Work for You
articles.summary: A pool expert tested the best robotic pool cleaners of 2026. The Beatbot AquaSense 2 Ultra is the top pick, but it costs $3,000 and weighs 29 pounds. There are cheaper options too, like the Dreame Z1 Pro for $499. These robots can clean floors, walls, and even skim the surface.
